استجنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَجَنُّوا (istajannū) /is.ta.d͡ʒan.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
# اُسْتُجِنُّوا (ustujinnū) /us.tu.d͡ʒin.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
# اِسْتَجِنُّوا (istajinnū) /is.ta.d͡ʒin.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
